limits: No hardware, live Android execution, packet capture, controller firmware or end-to-end tests. Static reachability does not establish availability on every controller/firmware.
Application symbols are obfuscated; complete original source recovery was not attempted. Some indirect Dart calls and UI routes are not fully traced.
frameCommit mapping is confirmed but no invocation/packet semantics established. Absence from collected xrefs does not prove unused.
Authentication/PIN and configuration authorization gates are not comprehensively traced by this subtask; map keys alone do not establish permission or safety of a write.
0000fff0 UUID remains unclassified; do not add it as a controller family based on strings.

trace_aot xref_index is a linear heuristic, not a complete CFG/dataflow analysis; manually verified immediate add+x27/ldr pairs and local instruction paths underpin these findings. Indirect calls, CFG joins and second ldp destinations limit automated xref coverage.
The bounded snapshot decoder stops after global ObjectPool; later object fills are not decoded. It is artifact-specific, not a general-purpose Dart decompiler.
publication_note: Interoperability address ledger. Method numbers refer to this artifact instruction table. Raw APKs, disassembly files and decoder output remain local and are not included in this PR.
